Holy Hour Shanbally: Wednesdays, 10.30–11.30am – Passage West: Fridays, 6–7pm CARRIGALINE PARISH PASTORAL COUNCIL NEW MEMBERS WELCOME The Carrigaline Parish Pastoral Council is a faith- filled group of people who work together to support the mission of Christ and help make our Parish a welcoming, supportive and vi brant community.
Why not consider joining? Your voice matters, and you don’t need any special experience, just a willingness to share your ideas and contribute to Parish life.

Being part of the Council offers an opportunity to make a real difference, support important Parish initiatives, m eet new people, build friendships and help shape the future of our faith community for generations to come.
We encourage anyone interested to consider getting involved.
Whether you have ideas to share or simply wish to playa more active role in your Church community, your contribu tion would be greatly valued.
Interested in joining? Please take home an Indication of Interest Form and return it to the church by
Sunday 29th November 2026, or express your interest by contacting us through
https://ourparish.ie/contact
Your voice matters.
Together, we can make a differe nce!

We share these thoughts from the Redemptorists: Mass of Remembrance — Our annual Mass of Remembrance took place last Sunday in St. Patrick’s Church, Noh oval, with a large congregation remembering 57 people who diedd uring the past year.
Families lit candles from the Paschal Candle in memory of their loved ones, creating a beautiful and moving display.

Sincere thanks to Fr. Michael, Deacon John, the Choir and everyone who helped make the ceremony so special. are especially grateful to all the priests in our Family of Parishes for their dedication, compassion and the beautiful Funeral Masses and homilies they provide throughout the year.
Novena of Masses — Thank you to all who attended our annual Novena of Masses in both churches and to the priests who celebrated the Masses.
